summary: @servicetitan/web-components preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the host platform/architecture (with Alpine/musl detection), unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, a global string-array with a rotator, and a custom decoder — its contents are fully opaque. The payload is not declared in the package.json `files` field (which lists only `dist` and `src`), is not referenced by any code in `src/` or `dist/`, and bears no relation to the package's advertised React microfrontend framework purpose. This is an alternate-runtime dropper: an alien runtime is fetched at install time solely to execute an obfuscated bundle on the installer's machine, bypassing Node-based scanning of the shipped source. The dropper artifacts (`setup.mjs`, `math_init.js`, the preinstall hook) are foreign to the legitimate `@servicetitan/web-components` package structure and consistent with a compromised publish under the ServiceTitan namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
